meta.title: Organise Your MCCx
meta.tagline: Bring Model City Council to your community.
meta.seoDescription: Model City Council puts young people in the role of city councillors — debating real civic issues and experiencing democratic participation.

whatIs.title: What is Model City Council?
whatIs.body1: Model City Council (MCC) is a public engagement event that puts young people in the role of city councillors — debating real civic issues, proposing sustainable solutions, and experiencing democratic participation first-hand.
whatIs.body2: Want to organise an MCC event at your school, college, or organisation? Get in touch with us to learn how.
whatIs.learnMoreAriaLabel: Learn more about Model City Council (PDF, opens in a new tab)

past.title: Past MCC Sessions
past.body: Photos and stories from MCC sessions at schools, colleges and organisations will be shared here.

steps.sectionSubtitle: Four simple steps to bring Model City Council to your community.

items.title: Express Interest
items.desc: Reach out to us via email or WhatsApp to indicate your interest in hosting an MCCx.

items.title: Coordinator Call
items.desc: A TIDE team member will connect with you to understand your context and co-design the event.

items.title: Plan & Prepare
items.desc: We provide an organiser kit: agenda templates, facilitator guides, and topic briefings.

items.title: Host the Event
items.desc: Run the MCCx at your school, college, or organisation with TIDE support throughout.
